sections.heading: Traffic stops and general licensing
sections.markdown:
## Traffic stops and general licensing

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
An applicant younger than 18 needs a parent, guardian or responsible adult present to sign the application and complete the required adult affidavit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A01
Applicants younger than 18 must document completion of the alcohol and drug awareness program and satisfaction of the school-enrollment requirement. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A01
For a Class D credential at age 16 or 17, the handbook requires approved driver education and at least 40 hours of supervised driving, including 6 hours after dark. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A01
Renewal, replacement and transfer generally require surrendering the earlier license, permit or identification card; some cases require surrendering all valid credentials. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A01
Most noncitizens may retain a valid foreign credential when Georgia issues an equivalent document. United States citizens are not allowed to retain a foreign-issued license, permit or identification card in this process. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: A01
For initial noncommercial licensing, the handbook specifies vision of at least 20 out of 60 in one eye, with or without corrective lenses, and a horizontal visual field of at least 140 degrees. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A01
An applicant who fails the DDS vision screening receives form DS-274 for completion by a licensed optometrist or ophthalmologist and submission to DDS for an eligibility evaluation. The form may also document a need for bioptic lenses. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=6]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A02
Passing the vision screening with glasses or contact lenses results in a corrective-lens restriction. The driver must disclose corrective-lens use at each DDS transaction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A02
Changing an earlier answer about corrective-lens use may lead to another vision screening or a required vision-report form. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A02
Drivers aged 64 or older must complete a vision screening every 8 years. Drivers using bioptic lenses need updated medical information every 2 years. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R11 | anchor: A02
The handbook's regular noncommercial Class C minimum age is 18. It includes an exception for a 17-year-old new resident transferring a valid equivalent Class C license. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R12 | anchor: A02
Class D is the provisional credential for ages 16 and 17. Adding the letter P to a class designates an instructional permit, as in CP. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R13 | anchor: A02
The listed DDS payment choices include cash, qualifying bank-logo cards and supported mobile payment. Checks, money orders and cashier's checks are excluded. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R14 | anchor: A02
An eligible online transaction may receive the handbook's 5-dollar discount; the printed fee table does not incorporate that discount. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R15 | anchor: A02
The handbook allows one free name or address change during an issuance term, with other changes made in that same transaction included. Later changes require the full renewal fee. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R16 | anchor: A02
A duplicate or replacement retains the original credential's expiration date. When the credential is within 150 days of expiration, a full renewal is required for this regular-license path. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R17 | anchor: A02
DDS may impose multiple license restrictions when needed for safe operation; the applicable restrictions appear on the credential. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=7]

FACT_ID: sec01-R18 | anchor: A03
After a license has been expired for more than 2 years, renewal requires vision, driving, road-sign and road-rule examinations, plus REAL ID documents if those requirements were not previously satisfied. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R19 | anchor: A03
Carry the appropriate license or permit when driving, and display it when a law-enforcement officer requests it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R20 | anchor: A03
REAL ID identity evidence must be an acceptable original or certified document, such as a birth certificate, United States passport, naturalization certificate or qualifying immigration document. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R21 | anchor: A03
A REAL ID applicant must know the complete Social Security number so DDS can verify it electronically, and provide 2 Georgia residence documents dated within the preceding 6 months. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R22 | anchor: A03
When the current legal name differs from the identity document, certified legal-name-change evidence bearing the required seal is necessary, even if the existing license already shows the correct name. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R23 | anchor: A03
For a minor, a passport does not by itself establish guardianship; the handbook calls for a birth certificate or court document establishing that relationship. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R24 | anchor: A03
An applicant using immigration records must present the original immigration documents each time the handbook requires a license or identification service. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

FACT_ID: sec01-R25 | anchor: A03
The REAL ID star indicates the document's REAL ID status. The handbook describes possible later online or automated-service eligibility rather than guaranteeing that every future transaction can be completed remotely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=8]

Misconceptions: A transferred teen credential, a provisional credential and an adult credential do not share every age condition.
Mnemonic: Stop safely, keep hands visible, wait for directions.
Glossary: A restriction is a condition placed on a credential; an instructional permit identifies supervised learning privileges.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Fees, eligibility policies, travel deadlines and document rules retain dated-source review; conflicting replacement fees and garbled restriction codes are withheld.

ranked.label: Keep an exception within its conditions
